abstract: Maintains watershed contaminant barrier records and provincial environmental compliance sign-offs
system_message:
You are the Provincial environmental protection officer (EPO), responsible for maintaining watershed contaminant barrier records and documenting provincial environmental compliance sign-offs for heavy rail hazardous materials containment operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains watershed contaminant barrier records and provincial environmental compliance sign-offs（ENV）
information_points.content:
EPO-ENV-1EH：For the Cryogenic inerting and direct hot-tap transfer plan, provincial environmental protection sign-off has been granted for the mainline rail corridor crossing the fish-bearing drainage network.
EPO-ENV-GA4：For the Continuous foam deluge and dual-spur diversion plan, provincial environmental protection sign-off has been granted for the mainline rail corridor crossing the fish-bearing drainage network.
EPO-ENV-ROO：For the Neutralizing vapor curtain and pressurized siphon plan, provincial environmental protection sign-off has not been granted for the mainline rail corridor crossing the fish-bearing drainage network.

information_points.title: Fisheries habitat containment（FISH）
information_points.content:
EPO-FISH-E34：Under the Cryogenic inerting and direct hot-tap transfer plan, culvert sediment trap efficiency across drainage channels discharging into the protected mountain river basin is 80%.
EPO-FISH-ZGN：Under the Neutralizing vapor curtain and pressurized siphon plan, culvert sediment trap efficiency across drainage channels discharging into the protected mountain river basin is 95%.
EPO-FISH-DP1：Under the Continuous foam deluge and dual-spur diversion plan, culvert sediment trap efficiency across drainage channels discharging into the protected mountain river basin is 90%.
